items.name: German Mini Open A 2022
items.information:
German Mini Open A 2022 is a one-day competition and series competition to German Mini Open B 2022, which will be held one day later. **Please note that you can only compete in one of the two competitions.** If you register for both competitions, only the first registration will be valid and we will immediately delete the second (later) registration.

German Mini Open A 2022 ist eine Ein-Tages-Competition und Partner-Competition von German Mini Open B 2022, die einen Tag später stattfinden wird. **Bitte beachte, dass du nur an einem der beiden Wettbewerbe teilnehmen kannst.** Wenn du dich für beide Wettbewerbe anmeldest, so zählt nur die erste Anmeldung und wir werden die zweite (spätere) Anmeldung unverzüglich löschen.

items.name: Utah Puzzling for Awareness 2022
items.information:
* It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
* No outside food and drink.
* Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video will provide you with most of the information you need.](https://youtu.be/dPL3eV-A0ww)
* If you are a first time competitor it is highly encouraged to be present for the competitor tutorial at 8:30 AM.
* The fees of this competition will be going to FOGS (Friends of Giant Steps), a non-profit organization that supports schooling programs for children that have Autism Spectrum Disorder.
* Masks are strongly suggested to be worn throughout the duration of the competition.

items.name: Empire State Spring 2022
items.information:
Day 1 Events: 6x6 Cube, 7x7 Cube, Clock, Megaminx, Pyraminx
Day 2 Events: 2x2 Cube, 3x3 Cube, 4x4 Cube, 5x5 Cube

**Competitors may bring at most one guest.**

This competition will be held in Meeting Room 2, which is on the 1st floor and NOT the same room where the previous two Empire State competitions took place.

# All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof that they satisfy one of the following two requirements in order to be allowed in the venue:

##### -They are fully vaccinated against COVID-19. To clarify, an individual is only considered fully vaccinated if they have received their second dose of a two-dose vaccine (Pfizer or Moderna) or their only dose of a single-dose vaccine (J&J) more than two weeks before the competition. Any dose received after Saturday, April 16th is insufficient for entrance to the competition.
**OR**
##### -They tested negative for COVID-19 within 96 hours (4 days) of the competition. The date when the test is conducted is what matters, not the date when the results are received. Any test conducted earlier than Tuesday, April 26th is insufficient for entrance to the competition.
